step1_analysis.description: A single-ended, highly linear transconductor that uses feedforward error correction and a regulated cascode-like feedback loop to maintain high linearity over a wide dynamic range. The circuit converts the input voltage at VREF into an output current at N_EA2.

paper_reference.title: A “Divide and Conquer” Technique for Implementing Wide Dynamic Range Continuous-Time Filters

power_consumption.description: Total DC power dissipated by the circuit.

sky130_expected.calculation: 4 NMOS current sources biased at 0.9V (Vov ~0.48V) with W/L=10 draw ~300uA each. Total current including feedforward and diff-pair branches is ~2mA. Power = 1.8V * 2mA = 3.6mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated using square-law approximation for SKY130 NMOS at VDD=1.8V.

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain = Gm * Rout. With Gm ~ 1mA/V and Rout ~ 100kOhm (parallel of short-channel PMOS and NMOS), Gain ~ 100 V/V = 40 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Matches typical intrinsic gain of a single-stage OTA in 130nm without cascoding at the output.

unity_gain_frequency.description: Frequency at which the open-loop voltage gain drops to 0 dB.

sky130_expected.calculation: UGF = Gm / (2 * pi * C_load). With Gm = 1mA/V and C_load = 1pF, UGF = 1e-3 / (2 * pi * 1e-12) = 159 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the load capacitance used in the testbench (1pF assumed).

phase_margin.description: Phase of the output signal at the unity gain frequency.

sky130_expected.calculation: Assuming a dominant pole at the output and non-dominant poles from internal feedforward nodes (A, X, Y, AP) at >1GHz.

transconductance_gm.description: Small-signal output current divided by input voltage.

sky130_expected.calculation: Derivative of output current with respect to VREF at the bias point.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on the bias current and W/L of the input differential pair and feedforward transistors.

linear_range.description: Input voltage range over which the transconductance remains within 10% of its nominal value.

sky130_expected.calculation: The feedforward error correction extends the standard diff-pair linear range (~2*Vov = 0.4V) to a wider range.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Adjusted for SKY130 threshold voltages and the specific highly-linear architecture.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, AC voltage gain, unity gain frequency, phase margin, transconductance, and input linear range. An inductor is used to close the DC loop while allowing AC open-loop measurements.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Highly Linear CMOS Transconductor Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm16=5u L_xm16=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm15=5u L_xm15=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm14=5u L_xm14=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm12=5u L_xm12=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u
.param W_xmp=5u L_xmp=0.5u
.param W_xm13=5u L_xm13=0.5u
.param W_xm17=5u L_xm17=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm18=5u L_xm18=0.5u
.param W_xm19=5u L_xm19=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u

* DUT
XM16 VDD VREF A GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm16} w={W_xm16}
XM9 A A X GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM15 X A X GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm15} w={W_xm15}
XM5 X VGM GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM14 N_LS1 VP VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm14} w={W_xm14}
XM10 Y X N_LS1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM12 VDD N_LS1 Y GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm12} w={W_xm12}
XM11 Y VGM GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}
XMP AP Y VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmp} w={W_xmp}
XM13 AP VREF N_MG1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm13} w={W_xm13}
XM17 N_MG1 AP N_MG1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm17} w={W_xm17}
XM2 N_MG1 VGM GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM8 GND AP GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM18 VP VP VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm18} w={W_xm18}
XM19 N_EA2 VP VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm19} w={W_xm19}
XM7 VP AP N_EA3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM3 N_EA2 VREF N_EA3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N_EA3 VGM GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}

* Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVGM VGM 0 0.9
VVREF VREF 0 dc 0.9 ac 1

* Load and Bias Network
* Inductor shorts N_EA2 to 0.9V at DC (for Gm measurement) but acts as open for AC (for Gain measurement)
V_OUT_BIAS N_EA2_DC 0 0.9
L_LOAD N_EA2_DC N_EA2 1G
C_LOAD N_EA2 0 1p

.control
* 1. Operating Point & Power
op
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print power

* 2. AC Analysis for Gain, UGF, and Phase Margin
ac dec 100 1 10G
let gain_db = vdb(N_EA2)
let phase = 180/PI * cph(v(N_EA2))
meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=10
meas ac ugf when gain_db=0 fall=1
meas ac pm find phase when gain_db=0 fall=1

* 3. DC Sweep for Transconductance and Linearity
dc VVREF 0 1.8 0.01
* Current from V_OUT_BIAS into the OTA equals the small-signal output current
let iout = i(V_OUT_BIAS)
let gm = deriv(iout)
meas dc gm_max max gm
meas dc gm_nom find gm at=0.9

* Calculate 10% linear range
let gm_90 = gm_nom * 0.9
meas dc vref_low when gm=gm_90 rise=1
meas dc vref_high when gm=gm_90 fall=1
let linear_range = vref_high - vref_low
print linear_range

quit
.endc
.end
